frases: Your treehouse is slowly killing the tree!
Hit like and follow. Flo built it in one weekend!
Two hundred nails, and a rope around the trunk. It's not going anywhere!
Every nail is a wound. Lots of small holes means lots of dead wood.
And that rope? The tree grows, the rope doesn't. It strangles the bark.
Builders say one big bolt beats a dozen small fasteners.
Special treehouse bolts. Just a few, and big. The tree heals around them.
Take it off. Nothing should wrap around the trunk.
And leave the tree room to grow, and to sway in the wind.
Fine. My treehouse goes on a diet. Fewer nails.
Two hundred nails, or a few big bolts? Team Norm or Team Flo?
